LBY.note: Nothing on rules or authority against AI harms.

facts.fact: The Audit Bureau head said it launched development of an institutional AI model, Diwan Bot, at the start of 2026 to support auditing and oversight analysis; it is described as in development.

LBY.note: Diwan Bot is for audit oversight, not a listed sector's public system.

facts.fact: The Audit Bureau head said Diwan Bot, an institutional AI model, was designed and developed entirely by young national talent in a project begun at the start of 2026; no release is stated.

LBY.note: Only a general reference to international standards for audit institutions; no IT or data standard named.
Diwan Bot is said built by national talent, not stated to be Audit Bureau staff; Athar's builder not stated.
